annotations.title: Schedule a callback of a finished call

description:
Schedule a new attempt of a finished call (same number, same task) at the time the user chose and get the scheduled time back, for instance when the callee said 'call back tomorrow after 3 pm'. Compliance: only on the user's request; limited to 3 callbacks within 14 days, at the exact time the user chose (no calling-hours window); turned off on lines where every call needs a new request from the user (error callbacks_disabled).

    Use it only after get_call shows done=true. To call another number or do a different task, use place_phone_call instead. The time is kept as given (at least 2 minutes from now); at most 14 days ahead and 3 callbacks per call. A real call will be placed at that time and paid like any call; cancel it with cancel_call.

call_id.description: The call_id of a finished call (status completed).
call_id.title: Call Id

callback_at.description: When to call again, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-04T15:00:00+01:00 (without a time zone, Europe/Paris is assumed).
callback_at.title: Callback At
